subject.title: fix(nvidia): sync recommended models with featured catalog

question: Should OpenClaw accept the NVIDIA catalog split where new setup and picker surfaces expose only the seven current featured models while five shipped older refs remain available only by exact reference in the full compatibility catalog?
rationale: The code and proof support the behavior, but this is an intentional compatibility-sensitive provider/catalog policy change on a PR with a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept The Catalog Split
options.body: Merge after maintainer/provider-owner sign-off because the PR retains shipped exact refs while aligning new choices to NVIDIA's current featured feed.

options.title: Keep Deprecated Rows Selectable
options.body: Ask for a patch that keeps older shipped refs visible in picker and onboarding surfaces if maintainers consider visibility part of the upgrade contract.

options.title: Pause For Provider Policy
options.body: Hold the PR if the NVIDIA provider owner wants a broader policy for deprecated live-feed rows before changing user-facing selection behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept The Catalog Split
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer/provider-owner sign-off because the PR retains shipped exact refs while aligning new choices to NVIDIA's current featured feed.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is provider/catalog policy at the plugin SDK boundary, where steipete has adjacent ownership history.
